description: This PHP class 'I18NTranslationDecorator' wraps around the I18NTranslation entity, providing methods to set related language and language string by ID. It uses traits for entity management and interacts with entities for internationalization translation aspects within the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: I18NTranslationDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class for the I18NTranslation entity facilitating setting language and language string by ID.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the decorator with an I18NTranslation entity.

methods.name: setLangStringById
methods.description: Sets the language string reference for the translation entity using a language string ID.

methods.name: setLanguageById
methods.description: Sets the language reference for the translation entity using a language ID.
